notes: A shot landing on a body: a short, dry knock (a band of noise at 560 Hz, 60 ms) on a small low thud that barely falls, a tenth of a second in all. Heard many times a second in a fight, so it has no ring, no snap and nothing above 2.5 kHz, and sits 8 dB under the family's level (gain -8): it is so short that the meter's 400 ms window reads it low, and the level keeps its knock under the peak. Short and dry in the middle, where a cast is a longer, hollow, falling thoomp.
